segments.normalizedSource: ```cpp // Retrieve the entity's texture coordinates. float2 uv = params.geometry().uv0(); // Entities loaded from a USDZ or .reality file use texture coordinates with // a flipped y-axis. This compensates for that. uv.y = 1.0 - uv.y; // Sample a value from the clearcoat normal texture. auto tex = params.textures(); half3 clearcoatNormal = realitykit::unpack_normal(tex.clearcoat_normal().sample(textureSampler, uv).rgb); // assign the result. params.surface().set_clearcoat_normal(clearcoatNormal); params.surface().set_clearcoat(1.0); ```
